name: Majo
source:
A wizard who holds the title of Witch, which is higher than that of a Magician.
She has also invented tools for using magic, such as magical machinery.
Although her abilities are recognized by the country, she does not serve at court and finds it troublesome to appear in public.

On the outside, she tends to appear to go at her own pace, but she is actually not very good at getting a sense of distance from others.

Although she looks young, this is due to the influence of her magic, and her real age is quite old.
